t: This is the site of the Hellenic College of London, a bilingual school in Knightsbridge. It no longer operates here; it closed in 2005. It was founded in 1980 by Constantine II, the former King of Greece, together with Queen Anne-Marie. Constantine was the last king of Greece, reigning from 1964 until the monarchy was abolished in 1973. That makes the school a link between the Greek royal family and London, set up after their time on the throne had ended.
